about.label: ABOUT
about.title: Skills & Background
about.p1: I'm a software engineer passionate about AI-powered products and reliable system design. I enjoy building solutions that combine practical impact with technical depth.
about.p2: My recent work spans healthcare software, blockchain applications, computer vision systems, machine learning pipelines, and intelligent automation.
about.p3: I'm currently pursuing an M.S. in Web and Data Science at Universitat Koblenz and actively seeking roles in software engineering and AI-driven product development.

optifit.desc: AI-powered full-stack fitness app with real-time exercise recognition and rep counting using MediaPipe and OpenCV, plus adaptive workout and diet plans powered by LLaMA 3.1.

ecomanage.desc: Scalable sustainability platform with workflows for data submission, approvals, waste categorization, emission monitoring, and automated reporting using React, Express, and MySQL.

hopnote.desc: AI-powered learning platform that transforms videos, audio, and documents into summaries, mind maps, flashcards, and quizzes using Gemini AI and LangChain workflows.

decentra.desc: Blockchain-based decentralized domain name system with secure registration, ownership transfer, and real-time dashboard using MultiChain.

playwright.desc: Automated UI suite using Playwright, Pytest, and POM to test portfolio and todo app flows including navigation, language switching, section visibility, and interactions across 11 test cases.

api.desc: Automated GitHub REST API validation suite for schema checks, repository existence, response-time benchmarking, and error handling across 10 test cases.

robot.desc: State-machine testing suite for autonomous robot fleet operations covering 7 robot states, mission lifecycle, fault recovery, and logging across 28 test cases with a live dashboard.

movie.desc: Movie recommendation system built on TMDB 5000 using weighted ratings and content-based filtering with TF-IDF, CountVectorizer, and cosine similarity.

exoplanet.desc: Kepler light-curve pipeline for exoplanet transit detection with preprocessing, Box Least Squares period search, feature extraction, Random Forest classification, and a Streamlit dashboard.

squat.desc: Pose-based squat form analysis pipeline with rep-level feature extraction and multiclass classification of correct, forward-lean, and shallow squats, including video inference and form alerts.

research.p1: Conducting a controlled empirical study on demographic bias in LLM fitness recommendations.
research.p2: Designed a hybrid evaluation combining human coding and automated extraction for exercise type, intensity, safety framing, and tone.
research.p3: Isolating demographic variables (gender, age, fitness level, goal) while controlling other prompt parameters to detect systematic preferences.
research.p4: Co-developing a reproducible prompt methodology and inter-rater coding rubric with a four-member research team.
research.p5: Synthesizing cross-model comparisons to identify model-specific versus general bias patterns.
